headline: Instagram content that drives collectors to the store and the website.
summary: Social strategy, content production and storefront policies for a trading-card-game and hobbies retailer in Canada — our international case.
challenge: New Rave (newrave.ca) sells trading-card games and hobby products from a physical store and a website. The community is knowledgeable and fast-moving: launches, pre-orders and singles matter, and generic retail content is ignored.
The brief was to grow footfall in the store and sales on the website with Instagram content that spoke to collectors, plus the storefront policies a serious TCG retailer needs.

workstreams.title: Social strategy
workstreams.text: Four content pillars: new launches and pre-orders, card features and USPs, direct brand promotion, and witty community posts that collectors actually share.

workstreams.title: Content production
workstreams.text: Static and carousel posts built on the retailer's supplied product mockups and brand assets, with AI-generated visual frames — never third-party card artwork — so every post stayed on-brand and cleared for use.

workstreams.title: Website support
workstreams.text: A full storefront policy set written for the category: shipping, in-store pickup, pre-orders, TCG singles, fraud prevention and grading.

results: Impact figures — follower growth, engagement, website sessions from Instagram, pre-order volume and store footfall — are published once confirmed with the client.
notes: Do not display third-party IP (e.g. Pokémon artwork or logos) in case-study imagery unless cleared; use our own creative frames or blurred versions.
